query_normalized: the impact of simulated social comparison on self-evaluation in online environments psychology
rationale: The paper focuses on the geographic spread and dynamics of trending topics on Twitter, which is an off-domain study regarding information diffusion rather than the psychological mechanism of "simulated social comparison" or its impact on "self-evaluation."
